dataset_description: Dealer-level sales revenue performance against assigned sales targets across the latest three reporting months, including actual sales revenue, target revenue, sales target gaps, and achievement percentages.

M1_Actual.description: Actual sales revenue for the latest reporting month (Current Date - 2 Months).

M1_Target.description: Target sales revenue for the latest reporting month.

M1_Gap_EUR.description: M1_Actual minus M1_Target. Positive = exceeded target, Negative = missed target.

M1_AchvPct.description: Sales target achievement percentage for the latest reporting month.

M2_Actual.description: Actual sales revenue for the middle reporting month (Current Date - 3 Months).

M2_Target.description: Target sales revenue for the middle reporting month.

M2_AchvPct.description: Sales target achievement percentage for the middle reporting month.

M3_Actual.description: Actual sales revenue for the oldest reporting month (Current Date - 4 Months).

M3_Target.description: Target sales revenue for the oldest reporting month.

M3_AchvPct.description: Sales target achievement percentage for the oldest reporting month.

trend_analysis_logic.latest_month_priority: Always prioritize M1 analysis — M1 is the most recent reporting month.

llm_instructions: Treat M1 as the most important month — it represents the most recent reporting period.
Always start the insight using M1 sales performance.
Compare M1 against M2 and M3 to determine improvement or deterioration trends.
Use M1_Gap_EUR and M1_AchvPct as primary insight drivers.
Use M2 and M3 primarily for trend analysis.
Highlight dealers consistently exceeding sales targets.
Highlight dealers consistently missing sales targets.
Highlight improving or deteriorating achievement percentages.
Highlight widening or narrowing target gaps.
Support every statement with actual metric values.
Do not invent business reasons, market causes, supply chain issues, customer behaviour, or operational explanations.
If M1_AchvPct > 100, describe the dealer as exceeding sales target.
If M1_AchvPct < 100, describe the dealer as below sales target.
If M1_AchvPct = 100, describe the dealer as exactly meeting sales target.
Use actual month names in the narrative and never use M1, M2, or M3.
Generate concise business-focused insights suitable for a sales representative preparing for a dealer discussion.
